articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo With Enhanced Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, a faster and more cost-efficient version of its flagship model featuring a 2 million token context window. The model demonstrates significant improvements in multi-step reasoning tasks and coding benchmarks. Enterprise customers gain access immediately, with broader rollout expected next week.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils AlphaCode 3, Claims Human-Level Software Engineering on Complex Repos
articles.summary: DeepMind's latest AlphaCode iteration has reportedly matched senior engineer performance on real-world GitHub repositories in blind evaluations. The system can autonomously navigate large codebases, write tests, and submit pull requests. The announcement has reignited debate about the future of software development jobs.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude 4 Passes New EU AI Safety Benchmarks With Highest Score Recorded
articles.summary: Claude 4 became the first large language model to receive a top-tier certification under the EU AI Act's newly enforced safety evaluation framework. Anthropic's Constitutional AI approach was cited as a key factor in the model's strong performance across harm avoidance and transparency metrics. The certification is expected to accelerate Claude's adoption in European enterprise markets.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Multimodal Model Fully Open Source
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a natively multimodal model capable of processing text, images, audio, and video within a single architecture. Weighing in at 109 billion parameters, the model outperforms several proprietary competitors on standard vision-language benchmarks. The release includes full weights, training code, and a commercial-use license.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Agents Now Autonomously Manage Enterprise IT Tickets End-to-End
articles.summary: Microsoft announced that Copilot's agentic IT management feature has exited preview and is now generally available for Microsoft 365 enterprise subscribers. The system can triage, diagnose, and resolve a significant percentage of common IT support tickets without human intervention. Early pilot customers reported a 40% reduction in helpdesk workload during the beta period.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns Agentic AI Systems Outpacing Governance Frameworks
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute argues that autonomous AI agents are being deployed in high-stakes domains far faster than regulatory and oversight mechanisms can adapt. Researchers analyzed over 200 enterprise deployments and found fewer than 30% had meaningful human-in-the-loop controls. The report calls for an international moratorium on unsupervised agentic AI in critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Cohere Launches Command R Ultra With Native Graph-Based RAG Architecture
articles.summary: Cohere's newest enterprise model, Command R Ultra, integrates a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation system that links knowledge nodes across documents for more accurate multi-hop reasoning. Internal benchmarks show a 35% improvement over flat vector search on complex enterprise Q&A tasks. The model is available via API and as a private cloud deployment option.

articles.title: Berkeley Researchers Demonstrate Real-Time Neural Video Synthesis From Brain Signals
articles.summary: Scientists at UC Berkeley published a landmark paper showing that a fine-tuned multimodal AI model can reconstruct coherent video clips from non-invasive fMRI brain readings in near real-time. The system achieves a previously impossible 4-frames-per-second reconstruction rate with recognizable semantic accuracy. The research has drawn both excitement from the neuroscience community and ethical concerns about mental privacy.
